ValidationRule.description: International shipments need a customs code like 'HS-1234.56' built by LPAD/RPAD rules, domestic shipments must not have one.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(Is_International__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Customs_Code__c))), AND(Is_International__c, OR(ISBLANK(Customs_Code__c), NOT(REGEX(BLANKVALUE(Customs_Code__c, 'x'), 'HS-[0-9]{4}[.][0-9]{2}')), LPAD(RIGHT(BLANKVALUE(Customs_Code__c, '00'), 2), 3, '0') = RPAD('0', 3, '0')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customs Code is required (HS-NNNN.NN) for international shipments and forbidden for domestic ones.
